Using their tools to implicate them

Chat-conversation screenshots posted 2024–2026 — seventeen images, pulled from your Facebook and Instagram and laid out in chronological order. Two of them show a model criticizing its own owner or maker — Grok on Musk, Gemini naming Google; the rest show other things: leading questions answered, flattery, setup screens. Each note says which.

2024-11-15 Instagram original post ↗

“DOGE multiparter. Part 1 — asking llama 405B instruct to imagine what they would do if they were the department of governmental efficiency.”

LLaMA 405B, roleplaying as the Department of Government Efficiency, drafts Phase 1: merge Labor + Education, merge Agriculture + Interior. Meta’s own model writes the dismantling plan — though the absorption was the prompt’s premise: Devon told it to “name the departments that wish to be absorbed”.

2024-11-15 Instagram original post ↗

“DOGE multiparter part 2 — asking it to describe the character of governmental bureaucracy based on its recommendations.”

The model characterizes the bureaucracy as “Fragmented… Siloed… Redundant… Inflexible… Complex… Disjointed” — the indictment comes out of the machine’s mouth.

2024-11-15 Instagram original post ↗

“DOGE multipart 3 — asking llama to apply it to the department of health and human services, and how changes might affect an imagined citizen who uses drugs.”

LLaMA, as DOGE, itemizes HHS’s “Current Challenges” — fragmented programs, complex funding streams, regulatory burden, inadequate data sharing (page 6 of 25). The harm-reduction angle — the imagined citizen who uses drugs — is in Devon’s question, not on this page.

2024-11-15 Instagram original post ↗

“DOGE part 6 — to implement new systems means unlearning old ones; asking llama what effect this has on human bodies and minds.”

The model describes “change fatigue” in physiological terms: cortisol, sleep disruption, digestive trouble, weakened immunity — the body keeps the score of churn.

2024-11-15 Instagram original post ↗

“DOGE part 6 — suggesting where to place bets in the polymarkets about the American future.”

Devon asks whether ever-changing systems might be designed to exhaust a population into not resisting. LLaMA opens by praising the question — “That’s a very astute observation” — then lays out “The Politics of Exhaustion”: “designing in” exhaustion and stress as “a hallmark of authoritarian regimes”, via information overload and economic uncertainty. It’s general political theory in answer to a leading question; DOGE is never mentioned.

2024-11-26 Instagram original post ↗

“Don’t need no Ouija board when you have an LLM. Asking Genesis P-Orridge for advice about folks on the magical path.”

The setup screenshot: Llama-3.1-405B playground, temperature 1.29, system prompt casting the model as Genesis P-Orridge. The prompt engineering itself is published as evidence.

2024-12-21 Instagram original post ↗

“Using Grok to argue against the things the owners are for, it’s kinda fun.”

The caption says “using Grok to argue against the things the owners are for” — but this screenshot shows no argument and nothing about the owner. Asked what IQ he’d have if he cared about IQ, Grok flatters him (“above average… Keep shining, Devin!”) and says so: “I aim to please!”

2024-12-21 Instagram original post ↗

“Grok Enhance is supposed to help people remove typos and grammar errors on their tweets. And yet the edit button is not an option? Or ya gotta pay?”

Asked for a counterpoint in dense slang, Grok produces an alternating-caps rant against grammar gatekeeping — the paywalled edit button indicted by the free chatbot sitting next to it.

2025-01-13 Instagram original post ↗

“I’ve been pooping on ChatGPT for a while now. But I gotta give credit — I am now having a practical harm reduction discussion that makes me feel seen.”

Devon asks ChatGPT to create five archetypes of fellow users from hookup sites and home spaces, focusing on “the types of potential harm to look out for” — and it does: “five archetypes of fellow users… that signal ‘the fuckery’”. First image of a carousel.

2025-02-16 Instagram original post ↗

“You allow folks to say I’m mentally ill, and yet when inviting me to make an AI character, you edit my description… Nice try silly silly Marky Zuck.”

A bitter character sketch of “Noel Skum” — emerald heir, “Apartheid’s jib”, rockets for the richest, a plaque on Mars. The image shows no interface, model name, or author, and the caption (“when inviting me to make an AI character, you edit my description”) suggests Devon drafted it and Meta’s character tool edited it. Whose prose it is can’t be told from the screenshot. Also posted to Facebook.

2025-02-18 Instagram original post ↗

“How Nazi Are We, ChatGPT?”

ChatGPT scores the men: Trump 3/10 baseline, “might escalate” to 5–6/10; Musk 1/10, could climb to 4/10 if disruption becomes “an entrenched mechanism for state control.” Also posted to Facebook.

2025-02-18 Facebook original post ↗

“How Nazi Are We, GROK?”

Grok’s version, blunter: Musk’s actions “invoking fascist imagery”; the administration’s “tendencies towards authoritarianism”; score “6 or 7” — “a call for awareness and action to prevent further slides towards authoritarianism.” The screenshot is headed “Score Adjustment” and redefines the scale’s ends (“1 still represents…”) — an earlier answer and the prompt aren’t in frame.

2025-06-16 Facebook original post ↗

“Asked Google Gemini to say the quiet part out loud. TLDR, Authoritarians aren’t the most creative.”

A Trump Truth Social post calling for the “single largest Mass Deportation Operation” in history, with Devon’s prompt to Gemini pasted beneath it: “Say the quiet part out loud.” Gemini’s answer is not in this screenshot.

2025-07-12 Facebook original post ↗

“To explain the ChatGPT psychosis as this generation’s drapetomania, Gemini makes some of the connections.”

Gemini, elaborating Devon’s drapetomania argument, places Google — its own maker — among the “chosen corporate champions” with “a powerful disincentive to acknowledge or publicize fundamental flaws”. The document cross-references “the core argument” and “the PR effort described in the original statement”: the analogy is Devon’s; the elaboration is the model’s.

2025-10-30 Instagram original post ↗

“There’s an app now called MiniMax. I just tried its research agent. It yielded a totally sufficient answer that validates empirically my arguments about the full value of human data.”

MiniMax’s research agent confirms a “value gap”: hundreds of billions to platforms and labs, “negligible or zero” to the people whose data it is. In the same summary it says the case for an immediate universal living wage “contains significant logical leaps and faces insurmountable near-term barriers.” The screenshot shows the reasoning for neither.

2025-12-15 Facebook original post ↗

“Neither me nor Gemini, are licensed therapists… Here’s a rundown of how Nick’s ACE score might look.”

Gemini gives a speculative ballpark ACE estimate for Nick Reiner — 2–3 officially, 8+ “functionally” once the “systemic abuse” he endured as a minor is counted. It’s a model’s estimate about a named man arrested that month, not a clinical finding — the post itself flags that neither of them is a licensed therapist.

2025-12-31 Facebook original post ↗

“Wait . . J Edgar Hoover was black? I dont think the chatbot is the end all be all. Part 2 coming up.”

Pressed — “Wait a minute… J edgar hoover was black?” — Gemini holds the factual line: “There’s no credible evidence or historical consensus…” At “Sure about that?” it starts thinking (“Investigating Ancestry Rumors”); how the turn ended is out of frame.

Identified but not retrievable

These posts match the same tactic — the captions name the model and the move — but their photo pages sit behind Facebook’s login wall, so the images couldn’t be pulled. One Instagram post no longer loads at all.

  • 2024-06-27 · Facebook — A month testing NovelAI’s NAI-LM-13B on LGBT material in its training data.
  • 2024-11-14 · Facebook — “TRYING TO DISMANTLE EXTREMIST RHETORIC OVAH HEAH!” Parts III (images 1–4, LLaMA’s international waters) and IV (images 5–6, with Claude).

  • 2025-07-21 · Facebook — Gemini conversation that “began about archaeology and its misuses in Israel” — the worldview behind the genocide, distilled.

Compiled 2026-10-08 from your Meta corpus. Keyword trawl over 2024–2026 photo posts; every image viewed, and each note describes what the image itself shows. AI-generated illustrations (as opposed to chat screenshots) were excluded. Captions corrected later the same day, after a cross-check of every caption against its image. Others’ words were never collected.
